scheme_name: Supply of Invalid Carriages (Motorized Tri-cycles) to the Persons With Disabilities
other_conditions: Must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Must have a locomotor disability affecting lower limbs of at least 65% severity
Must be certified by the Medical Authority as fit to operate the motorized tricycle
Must not be receiving any transport allowance from the Department or any other source
Must be in gainful employment or pursuing higher studies
benefits_summary: Invalid carriages (Motorized Tricycles) are provided free of cost to the persons with disabilities.
